title: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck near Mandalay on 28 March 2025
description: The earthquake struck at 12:50 MMT on 28 March 2025. Epicentre on the Sagaing Fault, 14 km north-northwest of Sagaing city and 16 km west of Mandalay. Shaking reached MMI X (Extreme) near Naypyidaw. Over 5,400 people killed across Myanmar, Thailand, and neighbouring countries.

markers.label: Epicentre (Mw 7.7)
markers.note: Sagaing Fault, depth 10 km. Coordinates from USGS via Wikipedia (exact).

markers.label: Sagaing
markers.note: 14 km south-southeast of epicentre. ~1,000 deaths; 90 % of structures destroyed. Approximate coordinates.

markers.label: Mandalay
markers.note: 16 km east of epicentre. 3,325 deaths (Mandalay Region). Approximate coordinates.

markers.label: Naypyidaw
markers.note: MMI X (Extreme). 665 confirmed deaths; airport control tower collapsed. Approximate coordinates.

markers.label: Bangkok
markers.note: 102 deaths (State Audit Office construction site collapse). Approximate coordinates.
